title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Container
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/v2.1.1/Container. Vessel or receptacle used for the temporary holding of waste (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.2.3.5). Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest per the SAREF4ENVI ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-2, clause 6.2.1.1.1); geo:Feature/saref:FeatureOfInterest carry no properties of their own to inherit. A container is restricted to accept at least one waste kind, serve exactly one perimeter, and have at least one collection point.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Container'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the container, expressed as a GeoJSON Point. Enrichment: Container formally subclasses geo:Feature in the ontology but the ontology itself does not fix a geometry type; Point was chosen as the practical representation for a single physical container.

serves.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/serves'. A container is intended to serve exactly one perimeter. Links to a Perimeter entity (or one of its subclasses: Building, City, Neighbourhood, CollectionOfBuildings).

hasCollectionPoint.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasCollectionPoint'. A container can be assigned one or more collection points (ontology restriction: minimum 1). Links to CollectionPoint entities.

acceptedWasteKinds.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from the object property 'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/accepts' (ontology restriction: minimum 1), whose range is the controlled vocabulary s4envi:WasteKind -- not modelled as its own entity since its members are a fixed set of named individuals rather than independently instantiable things. One or more of the waste kinds this container is intended to accept. Known individuals from the ontology (non-exhaustive, open vocabulary): 'BiodegradableWaste', 'FoodWaste', 'GardenParkWaste', 'ConstructionWaste', 'ConcreteConstructionWaste', 'WoodConstructionWaste', 'WoodWaste', 'GlassWaste', 'HouseholdWaste', 'PaperCardboardWaste', 'PlasticWaste', 'TextileWaste'.

containerKind.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from saref:hasFeatureKind whose range is the controlled vocabulary s4envi:ContainerKind -- not modelled as its own entity since its members are a fixed set of named individuals. The category of this container. Known individuals from the ontology (non-exhaustive, open vocabulary): 'IndividualHouseContainer', 'NonResidentialBuildingContainer', 'SharedResidentialBuildingContainer', 'VoluntaryDropOffContainer'.

massCapacity.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/MassCapacity'. Maximal capacity of the container in terms of mass. Unit of measure: kilogram (kg); the ontology does not fix a unit.

volumeCapacity.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/VolumeCapacity'. Maximal capacity of the container in terms of volume. Unit of measure: litre (L); the ontology does not fix a unit.
